visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An animated male character wearing a black tank top sits at a computer desk. Large gray numbers above his head rapidly count down from 2025 to 2010 against a plain white background. (2) The perspective shifts to a close-up of a vintage CRT monitor displaying a Windows XP-style desktop. A cursor moves to the Yahoo Messenger login window and clicks the 'Sign In' button. (3) The screen transitions to a logged-in state, showing a contact list and a guestbook interface. A message from a user named '小美' is visible with a date from 2010. (4) A chat window appears where the main character types a message and receives a response. The interface is purple and white with retro icons. (5) The screen displays the Yahoo! Kimo homepage, filled with various news links and banners typical of the 2010 internet era. (6) A montage of the Wretch (無名小站) social media platform follows, showing a photo gallery of several young men and a personalized blog profile with a dark theme and a deer graphic.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a rapid, rhythmic series of mechanical keyboard clicks and typing sounds, suggesting an intense user interaction. (2) A sharp, high-pitched digital chime occurs as the year transitions, followed by a classic ascending multi-tone chime characteristic of a legacy instant messenger login. (3) Continuous keyboard tapping continues with varying velocity, accompanied by crisp mouse click transients. (4) A short, buzzing mechanical vibration sound effect triggers during a simulated 'Buzz' action in the chat interface. (5) As digital pages are navigated, subtle whoosh sounds and digital UI clicks punctuate the silence. (6) In the final segment, a sentimental Mandopop ballad featuring a male vocalist and acoustic guitar fades in, establishing a nostalgic and emotive atmosphere with clear harmonic resonance.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To evoke a sense of nostalgia for the early 2010s internet culture in Taiwan by recreating iconic digital interfaces like Yahoo Messenger and Wretch, combined with a sentimental music track.
